children: RNS Number : 6834S  Marks and Spencer Group PLC  01 September 2026
In accordance with PRM 1.6.4R, Marks and Spencer Group plc (the "Company") announces that 285,136 ordinary shares of 1p each have been issued and admitted to trading as set out in the table below.
Details of the transferable securities admitted to trading
Name, type and ISIN of the securities
Number of further securities admitted to trading covered by this notification
Total number of securities admitted to trading following further issuance
Fully fungible with existing ordinary shares
Date of issuance and admission to trading
Issued on various dates between 3 August 2026 and 28 August 2026.
All issued shares covered by this notification were admitted to trading under an existing block admission for the Company's SAYE Scheme, last updated in July 2026.
